faq.title: Questions patients usually ask
faq.subtitle: UzMedAtlas helps you choose a specialty and send a request. A clinic coordinator then contacts you.

items.a: No. The symptom checker only suggests a medical specialty so you can find the right clinic. A doctor at the clinic confirms the next step.

items.q: Is a request the same as a booking?
items.a: No. A request is a callback. The clinic will contact you to discuss dates, documents, and whether the specialty fits.
The clinic’s international coordinator, using the channel you choose: WhatsApp, Telegram, phone, or email.
Prices on clinic pages are indicative. The clinic confirms the actual cost after reviewing your case.
The site is in English and Russian. Each clinic lists the languages its coordinators can speak.
We send your request to the clinic you chose so they can contact you. We do not sell patient data. See the privacy page for details.

how.limitsTitle: What this first version does not do
limits: It does not diagnose or prescribe treatment.
It does not book slots, take payments, or store medical records.
It does not open a patient or clinic cabinet.

privacy.title: How we use your data
privacy.updated: This notice is for the first MVP catalog and request form.
paragraphs: When you send a request, UzMedAtlas collects the details you type: name, country, phone, optional email, preferred contact method, planned arrival, and a short medical description or the symptom-checker answers you already gave.

We send that request to the private clinic you chose, and may keep a copy so the platform team can see that delivery worked. If you arrived from a campaign link, we may store the campaign source with the request.
We do not sell patient data. We do not create a patient account. Analytics events are stored with a random browser session, not with your name, unless they belong to the same session as a request.
If you sent a request in error, contact the clinic using the details on its page, or write to the platform team if a notify email is published for this deployment.
